topic.title: Previous RSNA Kaggle Challenges and Winning Solutions Compilation

comments.content:
Thanks for sharing the useful info about previous competitions in the RSNA challenge series.

  • Main differences between previous challenge and current competition in terms of
    data sets and evaluation metrics need to be brought out.
  • Getting started notebooks, models for ML training will be useful resources for competitors.
Thank you for sharing this information @quarkspark! It will be really useful for us all.
